evidence_families.independence_boundary: Reviewer/model perspective is externally adversarial, but re-executions share the accepted target, source repository and mechanisms; this is not independent runtime replication.
findings: Effect-authority, presence and V17 headline outputs reproduced in the audit table.
Effect receipt denominators cannot fall because failure aborts before receipt emission.
V17 advertises 18 checks although 14 final entries are hardcoded True and four are computed.
EXECUTABLE_POLICY_ORACLE only checks 13 Clay source substrings; it does not parse, type, lower or execute the Clay semantics.
Reported gate latency samples one repeated warm READ_ONLY branch rather than the decision space.
Named restart is a same-process connection reopen, not process crash/restart.
Root CLAUDE.md retains Andreas-PC mission anchors that conflict with the owner-fixed Hostinger target directive.
1000/1000 policy-field mutations changed request hash while four cognitive fields did not, supporting non-cognitive authority separation.
Sabotaging the Python V17 attempt guard still caused SQLite V17_REENTRY_CANONICAL_BINDING_MISMATCH through schema RAISE(ABORT) triggers.
scope_limits: Three prominent probe families were inspected; systemic extrapolation to roughly 200 probes is unproven.
No canonical database, external effect or production path was exercised.

evidence.claim: Structural, epistemic and dynamic roots separate bounded mutation classes and unknown persistent tables fail closed.
evidence.boundary: candidate mechanism; not canonical identity or causal use

evidence.claim: Query-relevant Graph semantic lesions left bounded assembly unchanged, while identical restored semantics changed full assembly via graph_epoch alone.
Bare selected-head digest does not identify root protocol/manifest domain.
LIVE_CAPTURE and REPLAY_BOUND use receipts differ at identical as-of time and cannot both be embedded into byte-stable semantic selection identity.
An incomplete approximate universe can mint a self-consistent SelectionReceipt; integrity does not prove completeness.

evidence_families.deduplication: These probes distinguish different composition properties but share source/project/runner ancestry; they are not independent confirmations of one broad Graph claim.

sources.claim: CPython -O removes assert statements and __debug__-conditional code.
RAISE(ABORT/FAIL/ROLLBACK) in a trigger terminates the current query with SQLITE_CONSTRAINT.
Provenance accuracy requires data generated or directly obtained by the trusted control plane; completeness remains an explicit concern.

concepts.claim: Every advertised receipt check should have a bidirectional witness: executed observation -> check result, and check result -> exact code/observation/falsifier identity; hardcoded success entries and pre-receipt aborts violate this relation even when the underlying mechanism is safe.

proposed_contract.rule: A count denominator contains only actually evaluated booleans. Reaching the end is a separate run-completed bit.

concepts.counterhypothesis: Binary fail-closed gates are sufficient for release safety; detailed partial receipts increase complexity and can leak or mislead without improving decisions.
decisive_test: Mutate every advertised predicate false one at a time and require a signed/readable partial receipt naming that predicate.
Run normal and python -O modes; semantic result and receipt schema must remain equivalent except explicit interpreter-mode provenance.
Replace Clay source semantics while preserving marker strings; EXECUTED_CLAY evidence must fail.
Measure whether reviewers locate injected faults faster and with fewer false classifications using bisimulated receipts versus current receipts.

concepts.claim: Evidence class must be derived from bound stage receipts rather than free text: SOURCE_PRESENT < PARSED < TYPED < LOWERED < EXECUTED < TARGET_EXECUTED < ADVERSARIAL_TARGET.
concepts.counterhypothesis: A strict linear lattice is too coarse because static proofs, schema constraints and differential execution are incomparable evidence modes.
concepts.synthesis: Use a vector rather than one rank: <source_binding, semantic_stage, execution_scope, adversarial_strength, recovery_scope, independence, reporting_fidelity>.
concepts.falsifier: Any label claiming a stage without its exact-byte predecessor receipt must be rejected mechanically.

concepts.claim: Project status must preserve separate axes for enforced mechanism strength and reporting/measurement fidelity; the audit demonstrates strong database invariants coexisting with weak receipt semantics.
concepts.counterhypothesis: Two axes still hide important distinctions; only the full evidence vector above is safe.
concepts.promotion_rule: No scalar PASS may average away a zero on semantic execution, crash scope or causal use.

concepts.claim: Before any worker reentry, a precedence graph over root instructions and owner-fixed directives must resolve one target-body identity or fail closed on contradiction.
concepts.counterhypothesis: Andreas PC may intentionally denote a development body while Hostinger denotes final acceptance; the apparent contradiction is a missing scope relation rather than wrong content.
decisive_test: Extract every target-body/mission-anchor assertion with source hash and precedence.
Require explicit scope labels DEVELOPMENT_BODY versus FINAL_ACCEPTANCE_BODY.
Re-run worker bootstrap and verify the resolved target is stable at T0 and material reentry.
Owner decision remains required before changing the root mission anchor.

concepts.claim: Graph identity can enter model-visible routing only when a query-relevant semantic lesion changes the bounded consumer output and a query-irrelevant lesion does not; epoch/root changes alone confer no causal authority.
concepts.counterhypothesis: The bounded assembly is not the true consumer; Graph may causally affect a later model or decision stage while assembly bytes remain invariant.
decisive_test: Trace the actual retrieval/assembly/model/decision consumer chain with typed identities.
Lesion query-relevant Graph content and require a preregistered downstream behavioral change.
Lesion query-irrelevant content and require invariance.
Shuffle epoch/provenance while restoring identical content and require semantic consumer invariance.
Separate selection integrity from candidate-universe completeness and root-domain typing.
